summary: Americas Gold & Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the closing of two previously announced agreements to settle delivery obligations. Under the first, the company issued 7,956,696 shares at US$5.57 per share to Sprott Mining Inc. to terminate a remaining obligation to deliver 592,000 ounces of silver. Under the second, it delivered 5,000 ounces of gold and issued 2,652,532 shares at US$5.86 per share to International Royalty Corporation (affiliate of Royal Gold, Inc.) to settle a remaining obligation to deliver 8,861 ounces of gold. The filing is a routine operational update on debt-for-equity swaps rather than a transformative special situation.
